content: Spreadsheet/CSV import debt: importers create duplicate records instead of updating (WooCommerce CSV import suite case), duplicate SKUs/serials block or corrupt imports, dates and reference keys mismatch, and dirty data becomes permanent once imported. Prevention: unique constraint on serial number with explicit upsert-or-reject behavior, dry-run validation report, staged import. For this project import is out of scope by decision, but the same debt arrives through manual data entry and any later one-off import script.
